prompt: Flat 2D cartoon illustration for a children's-book-style language course. Clean uniform dark-brown outlines, flat colours with at most one soft shadow tone, simple rounded shapes, simple friendly faces with small dot eyes, warm muted palette of cream, sage green, mustard, terracotta and dusty blue. Clean, readable composition with plenty of simple everyday details drawn as plain shapes, no textures. No text, no letters, no logos, no speech bubbles, no photorealism, no 3D rendering. Wide establishing shot of an empty location, no people, framed wide enough that every item in the description is visible and none is left out. A big, light living room on the second floor of an older Dutch brick building, seen from the doorway. Back wall: a wide window with a white frame and, to its right, a glass door to a small balcony; red-brick houses and autumn trees across the street. In front of the window a small round light-wood dining table with two chairs and a round pendant lamp hanging above it. Left: a dusty-blue three-seater sofa standing with its back towards the left wall, facing the window, a tall floor lamp right next to the sofa, and a large round mirror hanging on the wall above it. Right: the room's door, open, with a small grey bin just behind it, and an empty corner with bare white walls. Light oak floorboards, white walls, warm daylight.
